result.stdout:
ragnet - command-line access to a configured Rag.NET pipeline.

Usage:
  ragnet ingest <path> [--overwrite]   Ingest a file or a directory of files.
  ragnet query <question> [--top-k N]  Retrieve chunks relevant to a question.

Configuration is read from appsettings.json (next to the working directory)
or environment variables, under the RagNet section - see the README.

result.stderr:
Rag.NET configuration is invalid (5 problems):
- RagNet:ChatClient:Endpoint is required. Set it to the OpenAI-compatible base URL, e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1, or http://localhost:11434/v1 for a local Ollama instance.
- RagNet:ChatClient:Model is required. Set it to the model id to request.
- RagNet:Embeddings:Endpoint is required. Set it to the OpenAI-compatible base URL, e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1, or http://localhost:11434/v1 for a local Ollama instance.
- RagNet:Embeddings:Model is required. Set it to the model id to request.
- RagNet:Embeddings:VectorDimensions is required and must be positive. Set it to the number of dimensions your embedding model produces, e.g. 1536 for OpenAI's text-embedding-3-small or 768 for nomic-embed-text. It is currently 0.
